local function getNukeIds()
    local nukeIds = {}

    for _, Instance in pairs(tbl1.Nukes.folder:GetChildren()) do
        local var3 = tonumber(Instance.Name)

        if var3 then
            table.insert(nukeIds, var3)
        end
    end

    table.sort(nukeIds, function(arg1, arg2): boolean
        return arg1 < arg2
    end)

    return nukeIds
end

local function getCommanderIds()
    local commanderIds = {}

    for v, _ in CommanderData do
        table.insert(commanderIds, v)
    end

    table.sort(commanderIds, function(arg1, arg2): boolean
        local Rarity = CommanderData[arg1].Rarity
        local Rarity2 = CommanderData[arg2].Rarity
        local Order = Rarity and Rarity.Order or 0
        local Order2 = Rarity2 and Rarity2.Order or 0

        if Order == Order2 then
            return arg1 < arg2
        end

        return Order < Order2
    end)

    return commanderIds
end

local function getExplosionVFXIds()
    local explosionVFXIds = {}

    for v, v2 in ExplosionVFXData.List do
        if v2.Collectible and not v2.HideFromIndex then
            table.insert(explosionVFXIds, v)
        end
    end

    table.sort(explosionVFXIds, function(arg1, arg2): boolean
        local Rarity = ExplosionVFXData.List[arg1].Rarity
        local Rarity2 = ExplosionVFXData.List[arg2].Rarity
        local Order = Rarity and Rarity.Order or 0
        local Order2 = Rarity2 and Rarity2.Order or 0

        if Order == Order2 then
            return arg1 < arg2
        end

        return Order < Order2
    end)

    return explosionVFXIds
end

local function refreshCounter()

        return
    end

    local var3 = tbl1[str1]
    local num1 = 0

    for v in var3.entries do
        if var3.discovered[v] then
            num1 += 1
        end
    end

    local num2 = 0

    for v in var3.entries do
        if tbl1[str1].discovered[v] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible(str1, v) then
            num2 += 1
        end
    end

    Discovered.Text = num1 .. "/" .. num2 .. " Discovered"
end

local function visibleFrame(Instance: Instance)
    local vec = Vector3.new(1000000000, 1000000000, 1000000000)
    local vec2 = Vector3.new(-1000000000, -1000000000, -1000000000)
    local vec3 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local num1 = 0

    for _, descendant in Instance:GetDescendants() do
        if not descendant:IsA("BasePart") or not (descendant.Transparency < 1) then
            continue
        end

        local descendantCFrame = descendant.CFrame
        local Size = descendant.Size

        for i = -1, 1, 2 do
            for j = -1, 1, 2 do
                for k = -1, 1, 2 do
                    local Position = (descendantCFrame * CFrame.new(Size.X * 0.5 * i, Size.Y * 0.5 * j, Size.Z * 0.5 * k)).Position
                    local x = math.min(vec.X, Position.X)
                    local y = math.min(vec.Y, Position.Y)
                    vec = Vector3.new(x, y, (math.min(vec.Z, Position.Z)))
                    local x2 = math.max(vec2.X, Position.X)
                    local y2 = math.max(vec2.Y, Position.Y)
                    vec2 = Vector3.new(x2, y2, (math.max(vec2.Z, Position.Z)))
                end
            end
        end

        local num2 = math.max(Size.X * Size.Y * Size.Z, 0.001)
        vec3 += descendant.Position * num2
        num1 += num2
    end

    if num1 <= 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local var3 = vec2 - vec
    local var4 = vec3 / num1
    local X = var3.X
    local Y = var3.Y
    local Z = var3.Z

    return var4, (math.max(X, Y, Z))
end

local function loopAnimation(arg1, arg2): boolean
    if not (arg1 and arg2) then
        return false
    end

    local Animation: Animation = Instance.new("Animation")

    if typeof(arg2) == "string" then
        Animation.AnimationId = arg2
    else
        pcall(function()
            Animation.AnimationContent = arg2
        end)
    end

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return arg1:LoadAnimation(Animation)
    end)

    if not (success and result) then
        return false
    end

    result.Looped = true
    result.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    result:Play(0)

    return true
end

local function setupCommanderAnimation(Instance: Instance, arg1)
    if not arg1 then
        return
    end

    local Mount = Instance:FindFirstChild("Mount")

    if Mount then
        Mount = Mount:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
    end

    local var3 = (Instance:FindFirstChild("Commander") or Instance):FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
    loopAnimation(Mount, arg1.ClaimableMountIdleAnimation)
    loopAnimation(var3, arg1.ClaimableCommanderIdleAnimation or arg1.HelicopterIdleAnimation)
end

        local num2 = num1 * 2

        local Angles = CFrame.Angles
        local num3 = math.sin(num1 * 1.2) * 0.04
        local num4 = num1 * 1.5
        local var5 = var4 * Angles(num3, 0, math.cos(num4) * 0.04)

        for v, v2 in tbl2 do

        end

end

local function populateViewport(Instance2: Instance, Instance3: Instance, Instance4: Instance, arg1, arg2)
    if typeof(Instance4) == "string" then
        Instance4 = Instance3:FindFirstChild(Instance4)
    end

    if not Instance4 then
        return
    end

    for _, child in Instance2:GetChildren() do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("WorldModel") or child:IsA("Camera") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local var4 = Instance4:Clone()
    var4:PivotTo(CFrame.identity)
    local bool3 = arg1 and not var4:IsA("BasePart")

    if bool3 then
        local AnimSaves = var4:FindFirstChild("AnimSaves", true)

        if AnimSaves then
            AnimSaves:Destroy()
        end

        for _, descendant in var4:GetDescendants() do
            if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or descendant:IsA("KeyframeSequence") or descendant:IsA("AnimationRigData") then
                descendant:Destroy()
            end
        end

        var4.Parent = Instance2
    else
        if var4:IsA("BasePart") then
            var4.Anchored = true
        else
            for _, descendant in var4:GetDescendants() do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    descendant.Anchored = true
                end
            end
        end

        var4.Parent = Instance2
    end

    local Position, var5

    if arg1 and not var4:IsA("BasePart") then
        Position, var5 = visibleFrame(var4)
    else
        Position = nil
        var5 = nil
    end

    if not Position then
        if var4:IsA("BasePart") then
            Position = var4.Position
            var5 = math.max(var4.Size.X, var4.Size.Y, var4.Size.Z)
        else
            local boundingBox, var6 = var4:GetBoundingBox()
            Position = boundingBox.Position
            var5 = math.max(var6.X, var6.Y, var6.Z)
        end
    end

    local Camera: Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
    Camera.FieldOfView = 40
    local IndexCameraMultiplier = var4:GetAttribute("IndexCameraMultiplier") or 1
    local _ViewportOffset = var4:GetAttribute("ViewportOffset") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

    if arg1 and arg2 and arg2.ViewportOffset then
        local var6 = arg2.ViewportOffset.Position * var5 * IndexCameraMultiplier
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Position + var6, Position) + (arg2.ViewportCameraOffset or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    else
        local var6 = (if arg1 then var5 * 1.5 else var5 * 1.8) * IndexCameraMultiplier
        local Unit = (Vector3.new(-0.5, 0.4, -1)).Unit
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Position + Unit * var6, Position)
    end

    Camera.Parent = Instance2
    Instance2.CurrentCamera = Camera

    if arg1 and arg2 and arg2.ViewportModelOffset then
        var4:PivotTo(CFrame.new(arg2.ViewportModelOffset))
    end

    return bool3 and var4 or nil
end

        return
    end

        end

        return
    end

local function switchTab(arg1)
    if str1 == arg1 then
        return
    end

    local str2 = str1
    str1 = arg1

    for _, v in tbl1[str2].entries do
        v.frame.Visible = false
    end

    for v, v2 in tbl1[arg1].entries do
        v2.frame.Visible = tbl1[arg1].discovered[v] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible(arg1, v)
    end

    refreshCounter()
end

local function buildCategory(arg1, Instance2: Instance, arg2, arg3)
    local nukeIds = arg1 == "Nukes" and getNukeIds() or getCommanderIds()
    tbl1[arg1].total = #nukeIds

    for k, nukeId in nukeIds do
        local Instance3 = Instance2:Clone()
        Instance3.Name = arg2 .. "_" .. tostring(nukeId)
        Instance3.Visible = true
        Instance3.LayoutOrder = k
        local var4 = CommanderData[nukeId]
        local TextLabel5 = Instance3:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

        if TextLabel5 then
            if arg3 then
                local var5 = displayValue(nukeId)
                TextLabel5.Text = "Tier " .. BigNum.format(BigNum.new(var5))
            else
                TextLabel5.Text = var4 and var4.DisplayName or tostring(nukeId)
            end

            if arg1 == "Commanders" then
                TextLabel5.Visible = tbl1[arg1].discovered[nukeId] == true
            end
        end

        local RarityLabel3 = Instance3:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")

        if RarityLabel3 then
            local Rarity = var4 and var4.Rarity

            if Rarity then
                RarityLabel3.Text = Rarity.DisplayName

                if typeof(Rarity.Color) == "Color3" then
                    RarityLabel3.TextColor3 = Rarity.Color
                elseif typeof(Rarity.Color) == "ColorSequence" then
                    local UIGradient = RarityLabel3:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

                    if not UIGradient then
                        UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                        UIGradient.Parent = RarityLabel3
                    end

                    UIGradient.Color = Rarity.Color
                end

                Instance3.LayoutOrder = (Rarity.Order or 1) * 1000 + k
            end
        end

        local ViewportFrame2 = Instance3:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
        local var5

        if ViewportFrame2 then
            local ViewportTemplateInstance = arg1 == "Commanders" and (var4.ViewportTemplateInstance or var4.ClaimableCommanderTemplateInstance) or tostring(nukeId)
            var5 = populateViewport(ViewportFrame2, tbl1[arg1].folder, ViewportTemplateInstance, arg1 == "Commanders", var4)
            ViewportFrame2.ImageColor3 = Color32
        else
            var5 = nil
        end

        local Locked = Instance3:FindFirstChild("Locked")
        Instance3.Visible = if str1 == arg1 then tbl1[arg1].discovered[nukeId] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible(arg1, nukeId) else false
        Instance3.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        tbl1[arg1].entries[nukeId] = {
            animated = false,
            frame = Instance3,
            viewport = ViewportFrame2,
            label = TextLabel5,
            lockedFrame = Locked,
            model = var5,
            commanderData = var4
        }
    end

    for v in tbl1[arg1].discovered do
        applyEntryState(arg1, v)
    end
end

local function buildExplosionCategory()
    local explosionVFXIds = getExplosionVFXIds()
    tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.total = #explosionVFXIds

    for k, explosionVFXId in explosionVFXIds do
        local var4 = ExplosionVFXData.List[explosionVFXId]
        local Instance = ExplosionTemplate:Clone()
        Instance.Name = "ExplosionVFX_" .. explosionVFXId
        Instance.LayoutOrder = (var4.Rarity.Order or 1) * 1000 + k
        local Icon2 = Instance:FindFirstChild("Icon")

        if Icon2 then
            Icon2.Image = var4.PreviewImage
            Icon2.ImageColor3 = Color32
        end

        local RarityOutline2 = Instance:FindFirstChild("RarityOutline")

        if RarityOutline2 then
            RarityOutline2.ImageColor3 = var4.Rarity.Color
        end

        local TextLabel5 = Instance:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

        if TextLabel5 then
            TextLabel5.Text = var4.DisplayName
            TextLabel5.Visible = tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.discovered[explosionVFXId] == true
        end

        local RarityLabel3 = Instance:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")

        if RarityLabel3 then
            RarityLabel3.Text = var4.Rarity.DisplayName

            if typeof(var4.Rarity.Color) == "Color3" then
                RarityLabel3.TextColor3 = var4.Rarity.Color
                local UIGradient = RarityLabel3:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

                if UIGradient then
                    UIGradient.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        end

        Instance.Visible = if str1 == "ExplosionVFXs" then tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.discovered[explosionVFXId] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible("ExplosionVFXs", explosionVFXId) else false
        Instance.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.entries[explosionVFXId] = {
            animated = false,
            frame = Instance,
            viewport = Icon2,
            label = TextLabel5
        }
    end

    for v in tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.discovered do
        local var4 = tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.entries[v]

        if not var4 then
            continue
        end

        local var5 = tbl1.ExplosionVFXs.discovered[v]
        var4.viewport.ImageColor3 = var5 and Color3 or Color32

        if var4.label then
            var4.label.Visible = var5 == true
        end

        var4.viewport.ImageTransparency = 0
    end
end

local function buildMutationCategory()
    local mutationIds = getMutationIds()
    tbl1.Mutations.total = #mutationIds

    for k, mutationId in mutationIds do
        local var4 = MutationData[mutationId]
        local var5 = ExplosionVFXData.Rarities[var4.Rarity]
        local Instance = MutationTemplate:Clone()
        Instance.Name = "Mutation_" .. mutationId
        local var6 = if var5 then var5.Order or 1 else 1
        Instance.LayoutOrder = var6 * 1000 + k
        local Icon2 = Instance:FindFirstChild("Icon")

        if Icon2 then
            Icon2.Image = var4.Icon
            Icon2.ImageColor3 = Color32
        end

        local RarityOutline2 = Instance:FindFirstChild("RarityOutline")

        if RarityOutline2 and var5 and typeof(var5.Color) == "Color3" then
            RarityOutline2.ImageColor3 = var5.Color
        end

        local TextLabel5 = Instance:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

        if TextLabel5 then
            TextLabel5.Text = var4.Name
            TextLabel5.Visible = tbl1.Mutations.discovered[mutationId] == true
        end

        local RarityLabel3 = Instance:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")

        if RarityLabel3 and var5 then
            RarityLabel3.Text = var5.DisplayName

            if typeof(var5.Color) == "Color3" then
                RarityLabel3.TextColor3 = var5.Color
            end
        end

        Instance.Visible = if str1 == "Mutations" then tbl1.Mutations.discovered[mutationId] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible("Mutations", mutationId) else false
        Instance.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        tbl1.Mutations.entries[mutationId] = {
            animated = false,
            frame = Instance,
            viewport = Icon2,
            label = TextLabel5
        }
        local var7 = tbl1.Mutations.entries[mutationId]

        if not var7 then
            continue
        end

        local var8 = MutationData[mutationId]

        if tbl1.Mutations.discovered[mutationId] and var8 then
            TooltipController:AddTooltip(var7.frame, MutationVisual.FullDescriptionText(var8))
        else
            TooltipController:RemoveTooltip(var7.frame)
        end
    end

    for v in tbl1.Mutations.discovered do
        local var4 = tbl1.Mutations.entries[v]

        if not var4 then
            continue
        end

        local var5 = tbl1.Mutations.discovered[v]
        var4.viewport.ImageColor3 = var5 and Color3 or Color32

        if var4.label then
            var4.label.Visible = var5 == true
        end

        local var6 = tbl1.Mutations.entries[v]

        if not var6 then
            continue
        end

        local var7 = MutationData[v]

        if tbl1.Mutations.discovered[v] and var7 then
            TooltipController:AddTooltip(var6.frame, MutationVisual.FullDescriptionText(var7))
        else
            TooltipController:RemoveTooltip(var6.frame)
        end
    end
end

local function buildBaseSkinCategory()
    tbl1.BaseSkins.discovered[BaseSkinData.DefaultKey] = true
    local baseSkinIds = getBaseSkinIds()
    tbl1.BaseSkins.total = #baseSkinIds

    for k, baseSkinId in baseSkinIds do
        local Skin = BaseSkinData.Skins[baseSkinId]
        local Rarity = Skin.Rarity
        local Instance2 = BaseSkinTemplate:Clone()
        Instance2.Name = "BaseSkin_" .. baseSkinId
        Instance2.LayoutOrder = Rarity.Order * 1000 + k
        local TextLabel5 = Instance2:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

        if TextLabel5 then
            TextLabel5.Text = Skin.DisplayName
            TextLabel5.Visible = tbl1.BaseSkins.discovered[baseSkinId] == true
        end

        local RarityLabel3 = Instance2:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")

        if RarityLabel3 then
            RarityLabel3.Text = Rarity.DisplayName

            if typeof(Rarity.Color) == "Color3" then
                RarityLabel3.TextColor3 = Rarity.Color
                local UIGradient = RarityLabel3:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

                if UIGradient then
                    UIGradient.Enabled = false
                end
            elseif typeof(Rarity.Color) == "ColorSequence" then
                local UIGradient = RarityLabel3:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

                if not UIGradient then
                    UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    UIGradient.Parent = RarityLabel3
                end

                UIGradient.Enabled = true
                UIGradient.Color = Rarity.Color
            end
        end

        local ViewportFrame2 = Instance2:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
        local ImageLabel

        if ViewportFrame2 then
            if Skin.Icon then
                ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                ImageLabel.Name = "Icon"
                ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                ImageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                ImageLabel.Image = Skin.Icon
                ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = Color32
                ImageLabel.Parent = ViewportFrame2
            else
                populateViewport(ViewportFrame2, nil, BaseSkinController.BuildPreviewIsland(baseSkinId), false, nil)
                ViewportFrame2.ImageColor3 = Color32
                ImageLabel = ViewportFrame2
            end
        else
            ImageLabel = ViewportFrame2
        end

        Instance2.Visible = if str1 == "BaseSkins" then tbl1.BaseSkins.discovered[baseSkinId] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible("BaseSkins", baseSkinId) else false
        Instance2.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        tbl1.BaseSkins.entries[baseSkinId] = {
            animated = false,
            frame = Instance2,
            viewport = ImageLabel,
            label = TextLabel5
        }
    end

    for v in tbl1.BaseSkins.discovered do
        local var4 = tbl1.BaseSkins.entries[v]

        if not var4 then
            continue
        end

        local var5 = tbl1.BaseSkins.discovered[v]
        var4.viewport.ImageColor3 = var5 and Color3 or Color32

        if var4.label then
            var4.label.Visible = var5 == true
        end
    end
end

local function refreshCommanderRarities()
    for v, v2 in getCommanderIds() do
        local var4 = tbl1.Commanders.entries[v2]

        if not var4 then
            continue
        end

        local var5 = CommanderData[v2]

        if var5 then
            var5 = var5.Rarity
        end

        if not var5 then
            continue
        end

        local RarityLabel3 = var4.frame:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")

        if RarityLabel3 then
            RarityLabel3.Text = var5.DisplayName
            local var6 = RarityLabel3:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

            if typeof(var5.Color) == "Color3" then
                RarityLabel3.TextColor3 = var5.Color

                if var6 then
                    var6.Enabled = false
                end
            elseif typeof(var5.Color) == "ColorSequence" then
                if not var6 then
                    var6 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    var6.Parent = RarityLabel3
                end

                var6.Enabled = true
                var6.Color = var5.Color
            end
        end

        var4.frame.LayoutOrder = (var5.Order or 1) * 1000 + v
    end
end

local function buildAll()
    if bool1 then
        return
    end

    bool1 = true
    local UIGridLayout = ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout")

    if UIGridLayout then
        UIGridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    end

    buildCategory("Nukes", Template, "Tier", true)
    buildCategory("Commanders", CommanderTemplate, "Commander", false)
    buildExplosionCategory()
    buildMutationCategory()
    buildBaseSkinCategory()
    refreshCounter()
end

function module.Start()
    buildAll()
    CommanderRarityFlags.onChanged(refreshCommanderRarities)
    local TextButton = Tabs:WaitForChild("Nukes"):WaitForChild("TextButton")
    local TextButton2 = Tabs:WaitForChild("Commanders"):WaitForChild("TextButton")
    local TextButton3 = Tabs:WaitForChild("Explosions"):WaitForChild("TextButton")
    local TextButton4 = Tabs:WaitForChild("BaseSkins"):WaitForChild("TextButton")
    local Mutations = Tabs:WaitForChild("Mutations")
    local TextButton5 = Mutations:WaitForChild("TextButton")
    var1 = Mutations:FindFirstChild("unlocks")
    var2 = Mutations:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

    TextButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        switchTab("Nukes")
    end)

    TextButton2.Activated:Connect(function()
        switchTab("Commanders")
    end)

    TextButton3.Activated:Connect(function()
        switchTab("ExplosionVFXs")
    end)

    TextButton5.Activated:Connect(function()
        switchTab("Mutations")
    end)

    TextButton4.Activated:Connect(function()
        switchTab("BaseSkins")
    end)

    ScreenGui:WaitForChild("Left"):WaitForChild("SquareBtns"):WaitForChild("Index").Activated:Connect(function()
        FramesManager.Toggle("IndexFrame")

        for v in tbl1[str1].entries do
            local var4 = tbl1[str1].entries[v]

            if var4 then
                local frame = var4.frame
                frame.Visible = if str1 == str1 then tbl1[str1].discovered[v] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible(str1, v) else false
            end
        end

        refreshCounter()
    end)

    local var4 = DataController:Get()
    var4:ObserveKeys({ "discoveredTiers" }, onDiscoveredNuke)
    var4:ObserveKeys({ "DiscoveredCommanders" }, onDiscoveredCommander)
    var4:ObserveKeys({ "DiscoveredMutations" }, onDiscoveredMutation)
    var4:ObserveKeys({ "ExplosionVFXs", "Owned" }, onDiscoveredExplosionVFX)
    var4:ObserveKeys({ "BaseSkins", "Owned" }, onDiscoveredBaseSkin)

    var4:Observe({ "rebirthLevel" }, function(arg1)
        bool2 = (tonumber(arg1) or 0) >= 3
        refreshMutationLock()
    end)

    IndexVisibility.Changed:Connect(refreshVisibility)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            repeat
                task.wait(30)
            until IndexFrame.Visible and IndexVisibility.hasTimeWindows()

            for v in tbl1[str1].entries do
                local var5 = tbl1[str1].entries[v]

                if var5 then
                    local frame = var5.frame
                    frame.Visible = if str1 == str1 then tbl1[str1].discovered[v] and true or IndexVisibility.isVisible(str1, v) else false
                end
            end

            refreshCounter()
        end
    end)
end

return module
